solves.reasoning: Original text: 'American mathematician ... electrical devices ... foundation of AI'. (A) mathematician, (B) devices, (C) foundation. Only choice 4 has all three correct.
'famous for being the father' → famous. 'helped destroy German rockets' → destroy. 'became a full professor' → professor. Choice 2.
'was interested in' → interested. 'by inventing a machine' → inventing. 'machine capable of' → capable. Choice 1.
③ analog should be digital. Shannon's thesis was on DIGITAL computing theory. Other three words are contextually correct.
④ protect should be destroy. He invented a machine to DESTROY (not protect) German rockets in WWII.
① ceased should be continued. 'continued to teach for more than 20 years' — ceased means stopped, which contradicts.
'part of the _____ of Artificial Intelligence' → foundation. Standard collocation.
'interested in electrical _____' → devices. Natural collocation with 'electrical'.
'_____ to teach there for more than 20 years' → continued. Verb that takes to-infinitive complement.
famous synonym = well-known. Clear and unambiguous.
connected synonym = linked. Both mean joined/attached.
capable synonym = able. Both mean having the ability to do something.
interested antonym = indifferent. The other three (fascinated, curious, engaged) are all synonyms.
important antonym = trivial. Significant, essential, remarkable are all synonyms of important.
(A) master's program/thesis = graduate degree. (B) 'tried to master' = to become proficient. Choice 3: (A)-ii graduate degree, (B)-i to become skilled.
'account of a person's life written by someone else' = biography. Autobiography = self-written.
Preposition 'by' + gerund → inventing.
'capable of' + gerund → learning.
'worked to _____ by inventing a machine that helped destroy German rockets' → help win the war. WWII context.
'foundation of _____' → Artificial Intelligence. The self-learning machine was AI's foundation.
